title: An Inexact Augmented Lagrangian Method for $(L_0, L_1)$-Smooth Convex Optimization
summary: Augmented Lagrangian methods are among the most effective approaches for solving constrained convex optimization problems. However, classical complexity analyses of first-order methods applied within the augmented Lagrangian framework usually rely on the assumption that the objective function has a Lipschitz continuous gradient. This assumption excludes an important class of generalized smooth functions whose gradients may grow unboundedly.
